step1_analysis.description: A lumped-element pi-model representing an on-chip spiral inductor. It captures the main series inductance and resistance, along with feed-forward capacitance between turns and oxide/substrate parasitic effects.

paper_reference.title: Miniature 3-D Inductors in Standard CMOS Process

sky130_expected.calculation: Determined by the physical geometry of the inductor coil, modeled by Ls.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Based on the reported 7.8 nH value from the paper.

sky130_expected.calculation: Peak value of Im(Z11)/Re(Z11) across frequency.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Typical Q factors for standard CMOS spiral inductors are in the range of 5 to 15, limited by series resistance and substrate losses.

SRF.description: Self-resonance frequency where the inductor becomes capacitive

sky130_expected.reasoning: Calculated using L=7.8nH and estimated parasitic capacitance of ~70fF (Cf + substrate network).

step3_testbench.description: AC analysis to extract effective inductance, quality factor, and self-resonance frequency of the inductor pi-model by driving port 1 with an AC current source and grounding port 2.
